kinds.write_norm: the length (L2 norm) of what each block added to the stream at this position, computed here from the trace
kinds.readings: standard deviations from a typical fitted site, per layer and direction; present ONLY at the byte before a word that follows a determiner, where the directions were fitted; null elsewhere
kinds.probe: along the direction a probe READS adjective-or-noun from; positive points toward an adjective next
kinds.write: along the direction the model WRITES it with; positive points toward an adjective next
kinds.resid: along the part of the writing direction that is not a next-byte forecast
kinds.next_byte_forecast: along the forecast direction of the byte that actually comes next, when it is one of the 16 fitted
kinds.looks_back_at: for each looking-back (attention) stage and position: the five earlier positions it draws on most, with the weight averaged over the stage's 4 heads (the series' export)
kinds.each_head_looks_at: for each looking-back stage and position: each of its 4 heads' single strongest source, with its weight (the series' export)
kinds.knock_out_cost: CAL-1 R1: mean change in the true next byte's log-probability (nats) when that block's write is zeroed, beside what its direct attribution predicted
kinds.next_byte_logprob_true: log-probability the model gave the byte that came next (nats)
